summary: Methyltestosterone has FDA warnings, including its strongest boxed warning, regarding estrogen exposure and increased risks of uterine cancer, as well as tumors in the breast, cervix, vagina, and liver [6]. Based on a small computer model rather than tests on people, this drug received low risk scores for liver harm and heart harm [M]. Similar drugs carry severe warnings for issues such as heart damage, blood vessel harm, nerve toxicity, and immune system harm [3][4][5]. Additionally, a clinical trial involving a related testosterone treatment was stopped early due to a higher rate of heart and blood vessel problems in older men [8].
